speaker: alse_pinder
text: The same loaf, Mistress. Two fingers short. I did not pay him more than the penny.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny is the price. Bring it in. He has a play at two and a supper at six, and I am not feeding both.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Egeon at two. The Bell at six. The two pounds are still in the book. I will take them at five, if I take them, and not before I have a hat on.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not give them away in the street to feel like a countryman. Hear the answer first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will hear it. If it is yea, he writes the line where I can see it. If it is nay, the two pounds come home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At five. Not now. The garret has nothing that has to be finished before the play.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Dinner is at noon if you are in the house. If you are not, the pot does not wait, and neither does the penny.
